findings.evidence: AccessMethods.lean:38 `variable (V : Type) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]`; call sites :124, :142, :147, :153, :155, :157 all carry `(V := V)`. Contrast Basic.lean:47-49 `namespace DisKinematics` / `variable {V}`, which is why `K.Q2 g` (Basic.lean:57, :99) works.
findings.fix: Add `variable {V}` at the top of `namespace SigmaMethodData` (line 107) and `namespace ESigmaMethodData` (line 137), exactly as `Kinematics/Basic.lean:49` already does for `DisKinematics`, and drop the `(V := V)` annotations.
findings.issue: `variable (V : Type)` is explicit and is never re-bound implicitly inside the namespaces, so dot notation on the reworked API does not elaborate: `d.q2Sigma g` assigns `g` to `V`. Every call site must write `SigmaMethodData.q2Sigma (V := V) d g` instead. This affects `q2Sigma`, `ySigma`, `q2ESigma`, `yESigma`, `q2Sigma_nonneg` and `abs_q2ESigma_sub_q2Electron_eq`.

findings.evidence: AccessMethods.lean:111-112 `def q2Sigma ... := -g_met (d.kIn - d.kOut) (d.kIn - d.kOut)`; Basic.lean:52-53 `def Q2 (g) (K) : ℝ := - g K.q K.q` with Basic.lean:45 `hq : q = k - kPrime` — the same expression. Grep for `DisKinematics` in AccessMethods.lean returns no hits post-PR. AccessMethods.lean:125 `simp only [q2Sigma]`.
findings.fix: Add the bridging lemma, e.g. `lemma q2Sigma_eq_Q2 (d : SigmaMethodData V) (g : Bilin V) (K : DisKinematics V) (hk : K.k = d.kIn) (hk' : K.kPrime = d.kOut) : d.q2Sigma g = K.Q2 g` (provable from `K.hq`), plus a `@[simp] q2Sigma_def`; or drop `q2Sigma` in favour of `DisKinematics.Q2`.
findings.issue: After the statement change, `q2Sigma d g = -g (d.kIn - d.kOut) (d.kIn - d.kOut)` is the generic `DisKinematics.Q2` formula, but no lemma relates the two; with `all_methods_agree_ideal` deleted, no declaration in this module mentions `DisKinematics` at all, so a consumer gets nothing from the module's `Q2`/`xBj` theory. `q2Sigma_nonneg` also has to unfold the body (`simp only [q2Sigma]`) for want of a `q2Sigma_def`.

findings.evidence: `Module.Basis.coord` is `@[simps!]` (mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Basis/Defs.lean:663-665), generating the `@[simp]` lemma `coord_apply : b.coord i x = b.repr x i` — the one the PR's own provenance note (StructureConstants.lean:25-26) cites. StructureConstants.lean:115 `coord_lie_eq_sum` and :124 `repr_lie_eq_sum` are a matched pair; :130 `coord_lie_lie_basis` has no counterpart.
findings.fix: Add `repr_lie_lie_basis (i j k l : ι) : b.repr ⁅⁅b i, b j⁆, b k⁆ l = ∑ d, structureConstants b i j d * structureConstants b d k l`, mirroring the existing `coord_lie_eq_sum` / `repr_lie_eq_sum` pair, and note it in the provenance deviation list.
findings.issue: The PR makes `Basis.repr` the simp-normal form here (replacing `coord_lie_basis` with `repr_lie_basis` precisely because `Basis.coord_apply` rewrites the `coord` side), but `coord_lie_lie_basis` is left stated only in the `Basis.coord` form and has no `repr` companion. After `simp` normalizes a goal to `b.repr ⁅⁅b i, b j⁆, b k⁆ l`, this lemma no longer matches.

summary: Compatibility residue is clean and the prior round's JB finding is fixed, but the reworked AccessMethods surface is unusable with dot notation (explicit `V` forces `(V := V)` at every call) and is now disconnected from the canonical `DisKinematics` invariants it claims to reconstruct; StructureConstants leaves one lemma stranded in the form the PR just declared non-normal.
